Experience the power of a game-changing career 
 Are you looking for what’s next? We’re a global technology and services leader that powers the brands of the future. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.
 We are looking for a Customer & Technical Support Specialist to provide end-to-end customer, technical, and after-sales support within a blended support model. The role combines first-line customer assistance, advanced technical troubleshooting, and RMA administration, ensuring timely case resolution and professional customer communication.
 The ideal candidate will manage customer cases from first contact to closure, perform diagnostics and technical investigations, support warranty and return processes, coordinate with internal stakeholders, and contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. 
 Key responsibilities include: 
Handling customer requests via phone, email, and CRM systems
Performing basic and advanced technical troubleshooting
Managing incidents, escalations, and case ownership
Processing RMA requests, warranty checks, and logistics coordination
Maintaining accurate documentation and SLA compliance
Supporting internal teams with technical findings and case updates
Ensuring GDPR and data protection compliance
 Requirements: 
Experience in customer support, technical support, or service desk roles
Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
Excellent communication skills
Experience with CRM tools, ideally Salesforce
Ability to work in a structured, fast-paced environment
English proficiency
